subject.title: [Feature Request]: Multi-lane concurrency support for sub-agents via sessions_spawn

question: Should `sessions_spawn` support named sub-agent lanes, and if so must lane identities come from trusted configured profiles with both per-lane and aggregate concurrency limits?
rationale: The requested API and configuration are additive, but arbitrary model-selected lanes, precedence between limits, and the total resource budget are lasting product and compatibility contracts that source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Configured Lane Profiles
options.body: Allow only validated configured lane identifiers, retain the current default lane, and enforce both per-lane limits and a global aggregate ceiling.

options.title: Per-Agent Quotas Instead
options.body: Keep one scheduler lane and address workload isolation through target-agent concurrency limits tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8061.

options.title: Retain One Global Pool
options.body: Decline new lane/config surface and continue using the existing global sub-agent concurrency control.

recommendation.title: Configured Lane Profiles
recommendation.body: Allow only validated configured lane identifiers, retain the current default lane, and enforce both per-lane limits and a global aggregate ceiling.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is connected to the original spawn and concurrency design and has already participated in the item-specific maintainer review.
